purpose: Read-only evidence for the MCD-emitted host target_kind.

probes.marker_semantics: Markers are bounded, secret-free names of observed binaries, paths or active services. mcd.service is excluded and is never a positive marker.

classification.new_server: Allowed only when all five probes have installed=false and active=false, including no Mautic installation and no web, database, cache or PHP runtime stack.
classification.existing_server: Used when any probe reports an installed or active marker.
